question: Does this file make an earlier stage of a pipeline predict what a later stage will need, or a later stage make a decision an earlier one owns?

fine.in_order: Each stage decides what it owns from what the stages before it produced, or the file is not part of a pipeline.

violations.prediction: An earlier stage is handed, in advance, a count, reservation, size or shape that a later stage will need, because the stage that knows runs too late to say so: e.g. a register allocator told how many registers each op's encoding will want before any instruction has been chosen.
violations.late_decision: A later stage makes a decision that belongs to an earlier one, because that stage never made it: e.g. an emitter choosing registers, a renderer deciding layout, a printer deciding what is valid.

guidance: Name the missing or misplaced phase: what it is, what it would produce, and what the stages around it would stop predicting or deciding once it exists.
